ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, this is a schematic diagram of the orbits of two artificial satellites moving around the Earth only under the action of Earth's gravity. I is a circular orbit with radius R, II is an elliptical orbit, AB is the major axis of the ellipse, and AB=2R. The two orbits and the Earth's center are in the same plane, and C and D are the intersection points of the two orbits. It is known that when the satellite on orbit II moves to point C, its velocity direction is parallel to AB. Which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The accelerations of the satellites on the two orbits at point C are the same
